name: Laina
source:
One year younger than the rest of the group, Laina is Ross’s little sister and one of the most popular girls in school. Young, bubbly, and adorable, Laina’s upbeat and lackadaisical personality belies wisdom beyond her years and impressive skill with communication from her experience in the school’s news club.

Looking up to her big brother, she spends as much time with the group as she can, and tends to be the only one who gets Ross’s twisted sense of humor.
